title: The Garden at the Edge of May
description: The garden's movement final: spring bounces, a crumble causeway, lift boards, a low blossom-ceiling hop corridor, waterfall updrafts and a dash switchback — every exam in sequence. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

identity.scope: Monthly sample route; not a final five-minute day

rooms.name: The waking garden
rooms.lesson: Bounce into the garden · aim for the stone landing. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The fragile trellis
rooms.lesson: Cross the crumble causeway · no leaf waits. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The gardener’s lift
rooms.lesson: Ride the garden lift onto the high terrace. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The blossom walk
rooms.lesson: Stay low · short hops under the blossom ceiling. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The garden waterfall
rooms.lesson: Leave the waterfall onto the dry flower terrace. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: Above the whole garden
rooms.lesson: Climb the last switchback and look back over the garden. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: Flowers at the year’s edge
rooms.lesson: Link the final bounces to the garden gate. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.
